comment: The phone wheels uv.lock cannot hold: Android Pillow and the image libraries it links, Flet's prebuilt wheels from https://pypi.flet.dev/ pinned by index link and sha256 (owner RULED 2026-11-17, row RT-PHONE-PILLOW-ANDROID). Not in pyproject.toml/uv.lock: uv 0.12 (CI's pin) does not know the android_24_* wheel tags and refuses the py3-none library wheels under [tool.uv] environments; uv 0.13.9 locks them (seen 2026-11-17). The phone packager installs these in place of uv.lock's block for a name on a listed target (scripts/bundles/phone_wheels.py); a distribution's `companions` ship wherever it ships. pillow's version must equal uv.lock's (one version, the desktop's; the packager refuses a mismatch); the four libraries are the exact versions Flet's Pillow 13.0.0 build 2 requires (Requires-Dist ==). Every .so in them is 16 KB page-aligned (read 2026-11-17); flet-libjpeg 3.0.90 builds 1-2 are not. Bump all five together, for both targets. eternia-project-files-match is ripgrep's matcher for regex search_files (row RT-PHONE-REGEX-SEARCH-SHIPS-ON-ANDROID): built here by scripts/native/build_project_files_match.py (rustc 1.100.0, NDK 28.2, API 24, --locked, paths remapped), committed under crates/project_files_match/dist/ and pinned by repo-relative path (owner RULED 2026-11-21: "yea commit them to the hermes fork which is public"); a cold rebuild reproduced both sha256s bit for bit (2026-11-21), and the build script refuses one that does not. loaded_by names the module that loads it: it ships wherever that module ships. Bump its version with the crate's, for both targets. cryptography and cffi serve the phone listener's certificate (agent_runtime/gateway_tls.py; hermes row RT-ACCOUNT-ONLY-YOUR-COMPUTER-CAN-OPEN-THE-CALL-TO-YOUR-PHONE-WHILE-ETERNIA-IS-IN-FRONT): PyPI has no Android or iOS wheel of either. cffi and iOS cryptography are Flet's prebuilt wheels; Android cryptography is built here by scripts/native/build_cryptography_phone.py from PyPI's 48.0.0 sdist, linked against the interpreter's own libcrypto_python.so / libssl_python.so instead of Flet's static OpenSSL 3.0.20 (row RT-FU-THE-PHONE-ENGINE-DOWNLOAD-STAYS-UNDER-ITS-LIMIT-WITH-THE-LISTENERS-CRYPTOGRAPHY: -1.24 MiB deflated on arm64), committed under third_party/phone_wheels/cryptography/ and pinned by repo-relative path; a second build reproduced the arm64 sha256 bit for bit (2026-11-26). cffi is uv.lock's version; cryptography 48.0.0 is under the desktop's 50.0.0 floor and ships on phones only by the ONE named exception in scripts/bundles/phone_wheels.py (PHONE_ONLY_VERSION_EXCEPTIONS; owner RULED 2026-11-24: "for now use 48 but before release we need to update it file it as a deffered release row"), removed by RT-FU-BEFORE-RELEASE-PHONES-SHIP-A-CRYPTOGRAPHY-AT-OR-ABOVE-THE-SECURITY-FLOOR. Bump the two together, for all four targets.
